name: Stand Your Ground
body:
School transmutation; Level paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 min./level (D)

DESCRIPTION

You gain a sacred bonus to your CMD equal to one third your caster level; you also ignore the effects of the blown away, confused, cowering, dazed, frightened, knocked down, panicked, prone and slowed conditions for the duration of the spell so long as you do not move from you current location.
